suggestion: Process names must not contain design/implementation words (进行, 执行, 异常处理, 设计, 校验, conduct, execute): name processes as business object + business action (e.g. "collect item"), and move validation and exception branches into the process description instead of the name.

pattern: (处理|过程|闭环|流程|管理|等等|待定|TBD|etc\.)$
suggestion: Process names should not end with a generic word (处理/过程/闭环/流程/管理) or a placeholder marker (等等/待定/TBD/etc.): use a concrete business object + action, e.g. "collect item" rather than "favorites management".
Process names should avoid technical-implementation words (计算/转化/转换/拆分/日志/解析/编码/缓存/临时/筛选/排序): those belong to tech-stage subprocesses; keep process names at the business level.
